SOURCE: 21.7.41.

"As I learn from Mrs. BROH that her husband does not await his leave before the middle of next month, I am going to see meanwhile Mrs. Traute LOEWENHEIM again.

"By the way, Mrs. Traute LOEWENHEIM is calling herself Ruth LOHE and is telling me that she is engaged to a former secretary of Sir Robert Cecil".

B.8.c.
25.7.41.
